summary: Correct native current-work and root-tree parity fixtures

replay.detail: No projection, admission or replay changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or persisted formats change.

rules.detail: Effective work state, visibility, queue ranking and gate evaluation rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Production behavior is unchanged. Test fixtures use native actor qualification and the native diagnostic parser; replicated rows retain complete-field parity against uncached reads at the same Store snapshot and captured clock.

downtime.detail: Only the normal binary restart is required.

manual.detail: Existing stores require no manual action or coordinated upgrade.

recovery.detail: No migration is introduced; older binaries can read the unchanged database.
